reviews.text: We’re so grateful for our dog walker, Audrey. She is professional, reliable, and very flexible. She is fantastic at working with our large Saint Bernard, who is generally well behaved but requires management to avoid aggressive behaviors. She has been patient and ready to work with him! We don’t know how we’d get through the week without her! We definitely recommend Windy City Dog Walkers!

Windy City is great.  We had a lot of trouble finding a dog walker that was patient enough to get to know our reactive dog.  She has a lot of trouble learning to trust new people and strangers, but the dog walker was very patient and understanding.  We've been using them for years and they have been a life saver.  Would definitely recommend.

We have been using Windy City Dog Walkers for several years now and they take such great care of our dog Millie. They are very responsive to last minute changes and are very accommodating. The staff is very professional and kind, and Millie definitely loves her walker!  I always look forward to the daily updates with photos.

I definitely recommend this team of professional dog walkers!
Windy City Walkers is the absolute best! Ali has been truly incredible. They’re responsive, professional, and truly a life saver!
I used 3 different walkers with Windy City and they were all GREAT with my reactive dog. The company is very communicative and our walkers were all wonderful. I cannot recommend them enough.

I regularly used Windy City Dog Walkers for walks for my dogs for over 10 years. They are wonderful! Very trust-worthy and they take such good care of the dogs. I appreciate their easy-to-use portal scheduling and payments. I highly recommend them!

Best dog walkers in the City. Attentive to my senior dogs needs, including administering daily medicine, and walking at her pace. I couldn’t ask for anything more. Plus the 4 hour cancellation policy cannot be beat!!

I've been using WCDW for over 17 years and truly cannot say enough good things about them.The walkers are reliable, caring and truly great with my dog. Management is responsive and always quick to address any questions or needs. I also take advantage of their in-house dog sitting services so my dog can stay in his own environment as an alternative to boarding. Highly recommend to anyone looking for trustworthy and dependable pet care!

Reliable, dedicated and committed to the well being of my dog. I never had to worry about him for the 4 years they helped me. Scheduling is easy and Windy City is the best company I’ve ever relied upon and I’ve used dog walking services for over 20 years.

This is a great service and I highly recommend. I first found Windy City dog walkers through google search and then someone referred them to me so I went ahead and contacted them about walking our dog. They come twice a day three days a week and our dog loves our walker. We always have the same walker for our dog unless they go on vacation.  The communication with them is great. You communicate through an anpp and you can directly text your walker if they’d like.  They are fairly priced. We plan to continue with this service.

Windy City Dog Walkers has taken care of my pup in different neighborhoods of Chicago for years. They’re wonderful! They stay on top of communication and always send thoughtful updates with pics after each walk. If a sub walker needs to jump in, they always let you know in advance. They’ve taken special care of my senior dog with medical issues. Shout out to Kat! Thank you!

Amazing service, flexible scheduling system. Walkers are always great and made my nervous dog very comfortable.

All of my coworkers and friend also use the same company!

Can’t say enough good things about Windy City Dog Walkers. From the initial onboarding, to the app, to our incredible walker Alex, we are so incredibly happy with WCDW! Alex is an amazing walker who takes the best action pics of our Beagle and is always super responsive and detailed about the walk. From his pics I can tell how much our dog loves him. Entrusting your pet with someone is a huge decision and I would 100 percent recommend WCDW to anyone looking for a company that will take care of their pet like their own.

We’ve been using WCDW for several years now, and have had a great experience! Soba is leash reactive to other dogs, but her walkers have been fantastic in handling her big feelings. The team is also always so quick to respond to any questions and share any changes to the normal schedule (i.e., if our normal walker isn’t available, holiday reminders). While we’ve primarily used them for walking, they were able to help me with pet sitting when I couldn’t get Soba to boarding for a last minute trip. I could tell she was cared for the whole time via the updates and photos! Shoutout to our walker, Victoria, who is a superstar!!
This is a great service. They are great at communication and keeping us updated with how the walks went. Our walker is amazing and takes care of our dog as if it was her own.

We have used Windy City Dog Walkers since moving to West Town in 2023, and have been super happy with every aspect of their service. We have two reactive dogs and WCDW has been very accommodating and non-judgmental in ensuring their needs get met. We've had 3 different walkers since we started using them and each one has been 100% trustworthy and reliable. Their office staff are also incredibly responsive - my husband and I have busy, sometimes erratic schedules and they've consistently come through for us.

My walker, Susan, is beyond wonderful.  She feels like a member of our family.  Every interaction I have had with the office/staff has been stellar- they are responsive and understanding.  I cannot recommend this service enough!

WCDW provides me with peace of mind. The care they offer my dog during walks or dog-sitting is top-notch. The highlight of my pet's day is his dog walker's regular visits. The highlight of my day is the email note and picture they send me about his walk. I highly recommend them!

Susan has been an absolute gift to both me and my dog. From the very beginning, it was clear that this is not just a job for her—it’s something she truly cares about. She treats my dog like her own, with so much love, patience, and attention that it gives me complete peace of mind every single day.

She consistently goes above and beyond in ways that don’t go unnoticed. Whether it’s taking extra time on walks, making sure he’s comfortable, or simply giving him the affection he thrives on, Susan always puts his needs first. My dog absolutely adores her—and as any dog owner knows, that says everything.

It’s rare to find someone so dependable, kind, and genuinely invested in your pet’s happiness and well-being. I honestly couldn’t imagine doing this without her. If you’re looking for someone who will love and care for your dog as if they were her own, Susan is truly the best there is
Reliable, friendly walkers that my pup loves!

We absolutely love WCDW and highly recommend their services. The flexibility they provide, especially the ease of scheduling and the ability to have reliable backups when needed. It has made a meaningful difference for our family. They also offer great value for the quality of care they provide.

We are especially grateful for Scout, who has become such an important part of our Bernie’s life. She cares for him as if he were her own, and that level of trust and compassion is invaluable. We genuinely don’t know what we would do without her.

I have been using WCDW's services for 2 years now, and I have nothing but wonderful things to say about them. Both Paul and Daniel that I've had as walkers throughout my time have been amazing and I trust them so much to take great care of my dog week in and week out. Rain or shine they show up with a smile on their face ready to greet my pup and take her out for some fresh air.

All the office staff is great too and is timely with their answers and quick to answer when I have an issue or question. I would recommend them to anyone

We started using Windy City Dog Walkers over a year ago when I returned to the office and needed reliable care for our dog's lunchtime walk, and they have been fantastic.

We book multiple walks a week, and the experience (great app!) has been seamless. Scheduling is easy, they're consistently reliable, and on the occasions where our plans have shifted last minute, they've been wonderfully flexible. That kind of dependability means everything when you're trusting someone with your pet.

Highly recommend!

We are thrilled with the services Windy City Dog Walkers provides. Simone is absolutely wonderful with our big energetic lab, and they work around our ever-changing schedule offering flexibility and last minute accommodations. I also really enjoy seeing photos of my pup and updates about his walk on the app. I recommend them to anyone looking for a dog walker!

City Windy dog walkers are terrific. Super easy to work with, very warm and welcome as a new client. And Murdoch loves his new walker. I really like the consistency- Murdoch and his walker Lou get closer with each walk. Highly recommend!

I have been using Windy City Dog Walkers for about 4 years now and I can’t speak highly enough about the care my dog has gotten with them. Not only is my dog getting great care, their services work seamlessly on my end too. They are flexible with scheduling, it’s easy to make payments and they are easy to get ahold of in a pinch. If you’re looking for a reliable dog walking service who will make you feel comfortable and take great care of your pet look no further!
Windy City Dog Walkers is the best and most reliable! They are always available for walks on weekdays and weekends and all of the walkers we have met so far are fantastic! Highly recommend!
Daniel & WCDW are the absolute best! They are so helpful and reassuring, I always have peace of mind! I’m so grateful for this company and they’ve become part of our little family. Highly recommend!

I’ve been very happy with WCDW. My dog has one specific walker that comes every day, and he’s been incredibly dependable. Any time off has been planned in advance and coverage has been good on the few days he’s been off. My dog likes him quite a bit and he’s seems to have a good understanding of her quirks. He’s also handled any odd requests from me with ease. Management has been easy to work with.

I’ve been using Windy City for over 3 years. It has been such a relief to have a reliable, responsive, and trustworthy dog walking service. Ali has been my dog’s walker, and she never fails to fill up my dog’s bowl with water, take cute pics of her, and follow instructions perfectly. For the first few years, I was also a single dog parent with occasional unpredictable work travel. Windy City always found me an overnight dog sitter quickly despite often short notice and was accommodating through my schedule changes.

The whole team at Windy City Dog Walkers is amazing. You get a dedicated dog walker, and they do a free meet and greet at your place to make sure it is a fit. Jordan is absolutely amazing. Mermaid (my do) gets excited to see them, but Jordan is not hesitant to message in the moment with any issues and/or concerns, such as when Mermaid laid down and refused to leave for a walk. The admin team is also extremely responsive and not just before and right after you commit. The app through which you do communication, scheduling, and payment is intuitive and easy to use. They also provide daily walk report with pictures in the app. Overall, I can't recommend Windy City Dog Walkers more.

We have used Windy City Dog Walkers for about two years and the experience has been great. Their walkers and managers are all so kind and really seem to love and care about our dog. The app and scheduling features are super easy to use, and the team has been accommodating whenever we needed to change dates.

I’ve been using WCDW for 3 years now and every experience has been great!

My dogs favorite part of the day is when the team comes to visit him! And my favorite is the pictures they send after each walk!

I highly reccomend WCDW to anyone needing dog walking services!!

We’ve had a great experience with Windy City Dog Walkers! Our walker, Jeremiah, has been very patient with our pup who is a bit shy when warming up to new people. He has also been flexible to adapt to some of her health issues. The app makes it very easy to schedule and cancel walks based on our schedule and also easily communicate with the office and our walker. If you are looking for a reliable dog walking service in Chicago, Windy City Dog Walkers is a great choice!

Transitioning back to the office has been challenging but knowing my dog is in good hands has helped a TON. I get a sweet message and photo of my pup after every walk, the company communicates if any changes come up, and my walker handles my dog’s quirks with ease. Highly recommend Windy City Dog Walkers!

We’ve used WCDW for the last two years for our dog Holly and had nothing but great experiences! We’ve had multiple walkers over the years and they are all compassionate, responsive and very patient. Our dog is pretty timid with strangers, so we appreciate having an assigned walker and the free meet and greets to make sure it’s a good fit. They are very organized and make it easy to schedule walks and take care of communication and payment through an app. Great local business to take care of your pup!

Great service. Office staff is very responsive to inquiries. Our pup loves his walks with Kat, and Kat is super prompt with sending updates after walks. We really appreciate the peace of mind having someone we can trust give our pup an outside break when we are away at work during the day.

I couldn’t raise my dog without WCDW they’re so great and helpful. They’re very flexible with different timelines, days and availability. I have one dedicated Dogwalker day over day and she loved my dog like her own! They’re the best

I recently started using Windy City Dog Walkers and have been thrilled with their service. Daniel has been fantastic with my dog and communicates very well with me. I recommend them to fellow dog owners.

Windy City Dog Walkers have been essential to the care of my dog, Archer, for about 4 years now! Archer tends to be an anxious pup with many quirks and WCDW/his now regular walker Clarence B do a fantastic job in accommodating his needs and making me feel absolutely reassured when it comes to his care. I work in healthcare and tend to be gone for long shifts- WCDW is essential to our daily routine. Communication is quick and easy and if I’ve ever voiced a concern it was immediately addressed by staff. Excellent customer service and pup satisfaction!

We have had an incredible experience with Windy City dog walkers. We moved here from out of state and for the first time my husband and I both had to work on site and leave our pup at home all day. He has anxiety and can be a little reactive with other dogs so day care was not an option. We found Windy City dog walkers and they have been incredible from day 1. The team as a whole has always been responsive, up front with policies, and has very fair pricing. We love that they prioritize having the same walker each day, and Richard has been absolutely amazing. He is great with communication and sending updates with each walk. We can tell he loves our dog Winston. We can’t recommend them enough!
We have had such a wonderful experience working with WCDW! They’re incredibly responsive and accommodating, and have done an amazing job looking after our high maintenance senior dog.

Antwan has been AMAZING. Our dog loves him so much - she barks every time someone comes to the door, but gets excited and doesn’t bark when Antwan shows up. He’s kind, responsible, and reliable. Can’t recommend Antwan or Windy City Dog Walkers enough.

Highly recommend! My dog loves her walker (Ryan) and we always appreciate the post-walk updates and pictures. Very convenient to use / work with and incredibly friendly staff! Always trust that my dog is being taken well care of.
Reliable in a way I haven’t had with other services in past. Never missed a day. Reasonably priced and good experiences with the walkers themselves

We’ve been using WCDW for a year now and have had such a positive experience. Our dog is a little shy and our two walkers have always been very patient with him. I love getting his daily report card (with cute pictures) and the app is easy to use for scheduling.
Love WCDW! Reasonably priced, flexible. Emilka is so great! My pitbull LOVES her and I can tell it’s mutual. Great communication, love the daily updates. 10/10 reccomend

Very happy with the service we have received. From the beginning the customer service and attention to detail is exactly what we are looking for. Antwan has been fantastic with his updates and pictures post walk and our dog Luna is absolutely in love with him. I would highly recommend these services to anyone that wants their pets in great hands. We will continue working with them for all of our needs.
every walker from WCDW has been great! they’re very reliable and respectful!

Been using Windy City Walkers for a year now and can’t recommend them enough! My dog absolutely adores his walker, Ali! He is always smiling in his daily report card pictures thrilled to be going on his mid day walk. The mangers are always on top of finding a fill in or walking your pup themselves if your regular walker is off!
Receiving our puppy Gus' walk update is truly the highlight of my day. Gus enjoys his walks and I am happy to know he is in great hands with his walkers at Windy City!

We have had the best experience with Windy City.  They are incredibly professional with how they run the business.  Our dog walker, Dan is amazing.  He is so good with our dog and provides prompt post walk messages.  I can’t say enough good things about our experience these last handful of months!

Has been an excellent experience so far. Our dogwalker Julia is wonderful and our adore her. She’s prompt and reliable, and a great communicator. The business is also very responsive and organized and they portal is easy to use

We have had a great experience so far with Windy City Walkers. Several of our neighbors use them and so they were the obvious choice for us. Our walker, Jackie, always takes great care of our pug. Scheduling is easy, and they are flexible and responsive.
Super wonderful experience thurs far with my walker, Gabrielle! She has been super patient & gentle with my pup! Grateful for the easy scheduling & payment methods!

This service has been a game changer. I had so many rover walkers quit with little notice that I felt like I was constantly interviewing new people or struggling to keep a schedule. I’ve been using Windy City Walkers for almost 6 months and it’s been consistent and easy!
We love our current dog walker, and also more importantly our dog likes her! He has quickly become accustomed to her, which sometimes takes awhile!

Windy City Dog Walkers was quick to reach out after I had inquired about more information and was quickly able to get set up with a dog walker in my area. Service and communication has been great and my dog is exited to see his dog walker each week! Love the report card and pictures I get after each walk too!

We have been using Windy City Dog Walkers for almost two years now and couldn’t be happier with the service! Clarence has been our dog walker over that time period and we have gotten to know him well. Our dog Spira loves going for walks with Clarence and he always sends us a message right after the walk to let us know how things went he is very dedicated, knowledgeable and reliable and goes out of his way to troubleshoot and make sure Spira gets her walks even when we have forgotten to leave the spare key, or the garage keypad was malfunctioning, etc.. The company has an app that is very easy to use in terms of scheduling and the management has also been excellent and quick to reply to last minute scheduling requests, etc. we highly recommend Windy City Dog Walkers! You and your pup will be in great hands!

We're more than satisfied with our experience through WCW! The app is great and the team is professional. Our dog has a little bit of attitude, but Jesse has been patient and accomodating with her as they build rapport. Walks start at the right time and we get nice little summaries of how it went. Highly recommend.
Windy City Dog Walkers are reliable, friendly, and super attentive. They're very flexible and have been super helpful to me managing a busy schedule. Absolutely recommend them!

Windy City Dog Walkers is the best dog walking service!!  My walker is always on time and very attentive with my puppy and making sure she gets a good amount of exercise and interaction with other dogs.  I always appreciate the comprehensive post walk summary and good communication for logistics.  I highly recommend Windy City Dog Walkers!
We switched to Windy City Dog Walkers recently and have been thrilled with their service. Our walker Audrey is dependable and is already loved by our dog. The app is pretty solid too.

Great company! They are super responsive, flexible, and accountable. My experience with my dog’s walker, Michelle, has been wonderful. They always provide detailed updates and photos and my dog seems to really like them. On several occasions they’ve been able to accommodate walks on short notice when things have come up which I really appreciate!

Jesse is the best!  Using Windy City Dog Walkers has been one of the best stress reducing decisions I have made since having my two frenchies, Roxy and Romeo.  Gone are the days of juggling texts and messages from varies apps and walkers.  Now I just schedule weekly walks on the incredibly user friendly dashboard and I know my pups will be taken care of.  Plus, the incredible messages and photos after every walk are an added layer of reassurance and make my day.  Thank you Jesse and the Windy City Team!
Windy City Dog Walkers have been fantastic for us! Their flexibility, responsiveness, and genuine care for our pup is so appreciated. Highly recommend.

Incredibly happy with Windy City Dog Walkers. I have two ten year old dogs and we've worked with at least 5 walking companies over the years. WCDW is definitely the best.

The app makes everything super easy to schedule/pay and the office is extremely responsive - even during the Christmas holidays they found a vacation sitter for me for an upcoming trip almost immediately.

I've had the pleasure of meeting four of their walkers in person and they've all been incredibly attentive, adaptable, and diligent with providing updates, especially during overnight stays.

We’ve been using Windy City Dog Walkers for a few months now, ever since we started going back into the office for work. Ryan is our regular walker and he has been so great. Always consistent, detailed updates with pictures as well! Our dogs just love him. In addition, they offer easy booking and scheduling through the app and offer weekend services in case you know you will be out later than usual etc. So glad we found this service!

I have been using Windy City walkers for 6 months and couldn’t be happier! Our walker Erin is absolutely amazing with my pup and gives me a detailed paragraph after every walk with where they went, who they saw, what business my dog did, …

Love using this service! I’m very picky when it comes to my dog and I have been very impressed by Windy City dog walkers. I’ve even been able to easily schedule a walk within the same day. High recommend if you need someone to walk your furry friend
I've been using Windy City Dog Walkers for about a month now and have been so happy with the team! …

These guys are one of a kind. I've had 3 previous dog walking business in the past, and Windy City is the best we've had. They've been walking my dogs for 7-8 months now and I couldn't be happier with the service. Our walker, Jesse, is …

We have been using WCDW for about 3 weeks now and really could not be happier. When we first reached out, they were very responsive in terms of setting up a consultation phone call as quickly as possible and then arranging a visit to meet …
Rob and the whole team at Windy City Dog Walkers have been AMAZING with our senior dog. He loves going on walks and looks forward to them every day.

I've been having an amazing experience with Windy City Dog Walkers! We just moved to the area, and my dog is a bit hesitant of the new location. My walker Anna has been so sweet, patient, and communicative and I love that they take photos …

We love Windy City Dog Walkers! The app is great and they’re very responsive so so it’s very easy to book sporadic walks or visits. We did an initial meet and greet with our walker, Jordan, who took copious notes to make sure that all info …
